summary: Draft collinear AFM NiO PBE+U plan: SCF, bands, then DOS, preserving the input cell and site order.
notes: All 32 initial moments are preserved in input site order. Keep the input structure unchanged; no relaxation, SOC or hybrid functional.
Dudarev Ni U−J = 4.5 eV; oxygen has no +U.
NELM=120 uses the supplied default; relaxation settings are inactive.
Bands and DOS use converged SCF charge with ICHARG=11; DOS uses the mesh, not the band path (https://www.vasp.at/wiki/index.php/ICHARG).
AFM moments are initial seeds, not a ground-state claim (https://www.vasp.at/wiki/index.php/MAGMOM). Past runs use different structures and do not validate these settings or establish convergence.
